name: @intact-ebi/cytoscape-lumina
description: LUMINA: Layout for Uncovering Motifs In Network Architecture. Structure-aware layout extension for Cytoscape.js

scripts.build: tsc && cp src/favicon.ico dist/favicon.ico && cp src/index.html dist/index.html && cp node_modules/cytoscape/dist/cytoscape.min.js dist/ && cp -r data dist/data && touch dist/.nojekyll
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently "tsc --watch" "node watch.js" "http-server dist -p 8080 -c-1"
